_comment: Declared invariants for a stamped <field>-draft instance.  Nulls are
filled by the tier that produces them; sections.chapters fills at Tier 2
built_tiers gates check_drift's sections.  Every filled number gets a

sections._why_chapters: keys arrive from the APPROVED taxonomy at Tier 2; parts/versions/denominator per chapter arrive from PASS2 outputs at Tier 3 -- each record file's own header states its denominator
sections._why_min_attesting: a Version quoted from one paper is that paper's habit, not a move (PASS2_SPEC rule, carried from the parent)

uniformity_gate._why: filled from pipeline/recount.py at Tier 3 acceptance; the rule shape (>=2 of 3 axes across 3 consecutive paragraphs) is field-invariant, the rarity calibration is not

chapter_map._why: sample size from sample-keys.txt (pipeline/make_sample.py); A1 recall from pipeline/recall.py against groundtruth.json; A3 gate agreement recorded at Tier 2 acceptance (parent 94.4%, a mathematics instance 93.1%) -- positional jobs stay OUT of the gate (they are sliced by position, not judged from headings; the mathematics instance's first gate counted the abstract and manufactured 4 false disagreements)

structure_norms._why: the layers scripts/measure_structure.py writes to references/structure-norms.json at Tier 3 (check_drift asserts each is present); layer A (exact move sequences) is null unless a tagged round is run -- null means no claim may rest on it

canon_sources._why: the writing guides at field-config's canon_dir (canon_ingest.py writes a field's own set to references/canon-sources and fills this block): count = .txt files there, spot_quotes = {file: a line copied verbatim}, at least min(3, count)

_why_verb_ladder_counts: Tier 4: written from scripts/measure_verbs.py output; check_drift asserts each count appears in verb-ladder.md. An empty dict at Tier 4 is a FAIL (an unasserted ladder is inherited from the parent by default)
